concepts.def: Blended family — formed after divorce or separation; growing trend in Spain.
Same-sex marriage legalised in Spain on 3 July 2005 — among the first countries worldwide.
Civil partnership; regulated by regional laws across the autonomous communities.
Work–life balance — major policy area in Spanish labour and family law.
Casarse, separarse, llevarse bien — take a reflexive pronoun: 'me caso, te llevas bien'.
Fast-track divorce introduced in 2005 allowing dissolution without prior separation.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Independent Research Project — a core area of A-Level Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Independent Research Project brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Independent Research Project.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
